snippet.title: Fire Me, I Insist - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Workplace efficiency is at an all time low at Bog-Standard Solutions. You've been hired to sniff out inefficiencies and get rid of the rabble. Trouble is, everyone's up to something. Collect evidence, listen to gossip and tattle on your colleagues.

Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442770/Fire_Me_I_Insist/
